author: William James
title: The Principles of Psychology
notes: Volumes I & II combined. Foundational text for functionalist philosophy of mind.

author: Edmund Husserl
title: Logical Investigations
notes: English translation (Findlay, 1970). Sets ground for phenomenological method.

author: Henri Bergson
title: Creative Evolution
notes: English translation (Mitchell, 1911). Duration, consciousness, and élan vital.

author: Bertrand Russell
title: The Analysis of Mind
notes: Neutral monism and the causal theory of mind.

author: Ludwig Wittgenstein
title: Tractatus Logico-Philosophicus
notes: Ogden translation. Picture theory of meaning.

author: Gilbert Ryle
title: The Concept of Mind
notes: Critique of Cartesian dualism; 'ghost in the machine'.

author: Maurice Merleau-Ponty
title: Phenomenology of Perception
notes: English translation (Smith, 1962). Embodied cognition foundational text.

author: Ludwig Wittgenstein
title: Philosophical Investigations
notes: Late Wittgenstein; language games, private language argument.

author: Jerry Fodor
title: The Language of Thought
notes: Mentalese hypothesis; computational theory of mind.

author: Daniel Dennett
title: Brainstorms
notes: Essays on mind and psychology; intentional stance.

author: Daniel Dennett
title: Consciousness Explained
notes: Multiple drafts model; heterophenomenology.

author: Francisco Varela, Evan Thompson, Eleanor Rosch
title: The Embodied Mind
notes: Enactivism; phenomenology meets cognitive science.

author: David Chalmers
title: The Conscious Mind
notes: Hard problem of consciousness; property dualism.

author: Andy Clark
title: Being There: Putting Brain, Body, and World Together Again
notes: Embodied and situated cognition. Extended mind precursor.

author: Norbert Wiener
title: Cybernetics: Control and Communication in the Animal and the Machine
notes: Foundational text for control theory and information-based views of mind.

author: Marvin Minsky, Seymour Papert
title: Perceptrons
notes: Limitations of single-layer networks; influenced AI winter.

author: Allen Newell, Herbert A. Simon
title: Human Problem Solving
notes: Production systems and physical symbol system hypothesis.

author: Douglas Hofstadter
title: Gödel, Escher, Bach: An Eternal Golden Braid
notes: Strange loops, self-reference, and emergent consciousness.

author: Terry Winograd, Fernando Flores
title: Understanding Computers and Cognition
notes: Heidegger meets AI; hermeneutics and breakdown in computer use.

author: Marvin Minsky
title: The Society of Mind
notes: Agent-based theory of mental processes.

author: Rodney Brooks
title: Cambrian Intelligence
notes: Collected papers on behavior-based robotics; subsumption architecture.

author: Herbert A. Simon
title: The Sciences of the Artificial
notes: Design as a science; bounded rationality. Foundational design theory.

author: Christopher Alexander
title: Notes on the Synthesis of Form
notes: Mathematical approach to design problems.

author: Victor Papanek
title: Design for the Real World
notes: Social and ecological responsibility in design.

author: Edward Tufte
title: The Visual Display of Quantitative Information
notes: Data visualisation principles; chartjunk, data-ink ratio.

author: Donald Norman
title: The Design of Everyday Things
notes: Affordances, feedback, and human-centred design. Originally 'The Psychology of Everyday Things'.

author: William J. Mitchell
title: City of Bits: Space, Place, and the Infobahn
notes: Architecture and urban design in the networked era. MIT Press OA edition.

author: John Thackara
title: In the Bubble: Designing in a Complex World
notes: Sustainable design and social innovation.

author: Tim Brown
title: Change by Design
notes: Design thinking as organisational practice.

author: Ezio Manzini
title: Design, When Everybody Designs
notes: Social innovation and diffuse design.

author: Walter Benjamin
title: Illuminations
notes: Includes 'Work of Art in Age of Mechanical Reproduction'. Marxists.org has key essays.

author: Marshall McLuhan
title: Understanding Media: The Extensions of Man
notes: Medium is the message; hot and cool media.

author: Susan Sontag
title: Against Interpretation and Other Essays
notes: Erotics of art; form over content.

author: John Berger
title: Ways of Seeing
notes: Marxist critique of Western visual tradition. Companion to BBC series.

author: Roland Barthes
title: Image Music Text
notes: Death of the Author; rhetoric of the image.

author: Jean Baudrillard
title: Simulacra and Simulation
notes: Hyperreality; precession of simulacra.

author: Fredric Jameson
title: Postmodernism, or, The Cultural Logic of Late Capitalism
notes: Aesthetic of postmodernism as expression of late capitalism.

author: Lev Manovich
title: The Language of New Media
notes: Database logic; cinema and new media aesthetics.

author: Boris Groys
title: Art Power
notes: Contemporary art and political power; biopolitics of art.

author: Thomas S. Kuhn
title: The Structure of Scientific Revolutions
notes: Paradigm shifts; incommensurability. Key interdisciplinary text.

author: Gregory Bateson
title: Steps to an Ecology of Mind
notes: Pattern connecting cybernetics, anthropology, and mind.

author: Paul Virilio
title: Speed and Politics
notes: Dromology; speed as political force. Cross-field: urbanism, war, media.

author: Donna Haraway
title: Simians, Cyborgs, and Women
notes: Cyborg Manifesto and related essays. Science studies meets feminism.

author: Bruno Latour
title: We Have Never Been Modern
notes: Actor-network theory precursor; critique of modernity's purification.

author: N. Katherine Hayles
title: How We Became Posthuman
notes: Information and embodiment; cybernetics and literature.

author: Yuk Hui
title: Recursivity and Contingency
notes: Organic and machine thought; Hegel, Simondon, and AI.
